segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the final order form for the service desk rollout and make sure we're clean on seats, dates, and billing before I send it to signature.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. We are still at 84 agent seats, right? Forty-six for support, 22 for operations, and then 16 shared admins.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct, 84 paid agent seats. The read-only requester access is unlimited, so your 310 internal users won't count against that. Annual total is $58,380 after the 12% discount, billed up front.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Finance asked if the invoice can show the cost center split, 70% support and 30% ops. They don't need two invoices, just the line note.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, I put that in the billing notes. Payment terms are net 30, start date June 1, and the initial term runs through May 31 next year.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. What about the data import? We had May 10 on the calendar because our current tool renewal hits May 20.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so I owe you an apology there. I confirmed May 10 with you, but it didn't make it into the implementation ticket, so the services team had you down for May 17. I talked to the manager this morning and they can still start the import May 10, but the validation call moves to May 14 at 2:00 Eastern.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that's not ideal, but May 14 works. We just need the tickets and user history checked before our admin training.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Understood. Admin training is still May 16, two hours, remote, with up to 12 admins. I'll attach the agenda to the order form email and copy your project lead.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send the order form to me and Marcus in procurement. If the numbers match what you just said, we can turn it around by Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I'll send it today with the pricing sheet summary, the cost center note, and the updated implementation dates.
